Our seminar coordinators introduce this month's recommended WEB seminars.

【Title】
Accounting Fundamentals for Accounting Staff: Understanding Financial Statements

【Instructor】
Hiroki Imazeki (Certified Tax Accountant)

【Overview】
A comprehensive course covering accounting practice from journal entries and ledgers through to financial statements and how to read them. You'll develop the ability to understand a company's financial position and performance from the numbers, and gain the confidence to answer the president's questions. Refresh your accounting fundamentals and raise the quality of your work! (Recorded: June 9, 2026) (Available until: September 30, 2026) (71 minutes)

※Viewing WEB seminars is a member benefit of Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry. Member businesses wishing to receive the ID and password needed to view the seminars should contact your representative.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2640/
